name: hosting_composer
description: Active Next.js SDK list for the hosting shell (composed by The-Rokct-Protocol core/utils/nextjs/sdk_composer.py)
_comment: No 'hosting' registry template exists in core/utils/frappe/composer/ today, so the composer's legacy path reads this committed composer.json as-is (.rokct/config/app_type 'hosting' acts as a plain role marker). If a hosting.json registry template lands with an 'sdks' array, it becomes canonical and wins over this committed copy; mirror any change here into it then.
